item.title: Tyrese Maxey breaks down what's been going right for Philadelphia 76ers
item.description: Tyrese Maxey joins NBA Showtime to break down the state of the Sixers, Joel Embiid's recent performance, what it means to be an All-Star starter, and the competition in the Eastern Conference.

item.title: Analyzing timing of reported James Harden trade buzz
item.description: NBA Showtime breaks down the timing of the reports surrounding a James Harden-Darius Garland swap and why this news comes as a "shock" amid the Clippers' season turnaround.

item.title: Early 2026 NBA League Pass rankings with Hornets, Thunder and more
item.description: Kenny Beecham updates his NBA League Pass rankings as the NBA trade deadline approaches, including teams you most likely don't like but probably should and some of the cream of the crop.

item.title: 76ers race out to early lead behind Tyrese Maxey, cruise to 128-113 win against Clippers
item.description: The Clippers looked tired and distracted on the night news of a possible James Harden trade broke.
